notes.title: Gamepad mode has been added to the game!
notes.notes:
Finally it happened! You asked a lot that I add gamepad controls to the game, and now it has been added! Playing with a gamepad is a bit tricky at first, but getting used to it becomes very easy.
Before posting this update, I reviewed the game and I can safely say that it is possible to pass Bloodway Infinity from a gamepad! What are you waiting for? Right now download the update from the link and texture the gamepad (if you have one, of course).
